# `armadad server`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

Run the control plane (and, by default, this node's agent).

Every control plane node runs `armadad server`. They elect a leader, which serves
the API and runs the reconcilers; the others stand by and take over within
seconds if it fails. Add control plane nodes with `armadad server join`.

```
armadad server [flags]
```

Also: `servers`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--acme-ca string` | ACME directory: letsencrypt, letsencrypt-staging, or an https:// URL (default `letsencrypt`) |
| `--acme-email string` | contact email for the ACME account |
| `--acme-listen string` | private ip:port for HTTP-01 challenges forwarded by HAProxy (default: <server ip>:7480) |
| `--agent` | also run this node's agent (default `true`) |
| `--data-dir string` | directory for cluster state and keys (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
| `--dns-provider string` | DNS provider for certificates of the root domain and the names under it, including a wildcard: cloudflare |
| `--dns-token-file string` | file (mode 0600) holding the DNS provider API token |
| `--internal-dns` | serve <app>.internal to containers on this node (needs --proxy haproxy) (default `true`) |
| `--join-listen string` | private ip:port for joining nodes (default: API port + 1; "off" disables joining) |
| `--log-format string` | log format: text or json (default `text`) |
| `--metrics-listen string` | private ip:port for the Prometheus metrics endpoint, served by the leader to metrics and admin certificates (default: off) |
| `--node-lost-timeout duration` | how long a node may be unreachable before its replicas move to other nodes (default `5m0s`) |
| `--proxy string` | ingress proxy for the embedded agent: haproxy or none (default `haproxy`) |
| `--secrets-dir string` | tmpfs directory for the embedded agent's secret files (default `/run/armada/secrets`) |
| `--tls` | obtain and renew TLS certificates with ACME (default `true`) |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | debug logging |

## `armadad server join`

Add this machine to the cluster as a control plane node. Get ADDR, the token,
and the CA hash from `armada server join-token`. The CA hash pins the
cluster CA, so a machine in the middle cannot pose as the server.

The new server receives the cluster CA key and the secrets master key, so the
token is as sensitive as they are. It is read from --token-file, a hidden
prompt, or stdin; never from an argument. Afterwards, run `armadad server`.

Like `armadad init`, it writes /etc/armada/admin.config for the machine's
cluster-admins (group armada) and ~/.armada/config of the person running it
through sudo, both with a certificate for --user-name signed by the cluster CA.
The certificate has the rights the cluster gives that user; a name the cluster
has no record of is a cluster-admin, as the first user is. Existing files stay.

Run three control plane nodes to tolerate the loss of one; with two, losing
either stops the control plane.

```
armadad server join ADDR --ca-hash sha256:HEX [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--ca-hash string` | cluster CA hash, sha256:... |
| `--container-subnet string` | private IPv4 subnet for this node's containers (clusters without a cluster network; others give each node a subnet) (default `10.121.0.0/24`) |
| `--data-dir string` | directory for cluster state and keys (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
| `--join-port int` | join listener port on the private IP (default: --port + 1) |
| `--name string` | server and node name (default: hostname) |
| `--port int` | control plane port on the private IP (default `7443`) |
| `--private-ip string` | this machine's private IP (default: the only private IPv4 address) |
| `--token-file string` | file holding the server token (default: prompt or stdin) |
| `--user-name string` | user named in the client configs written here (default: the user running it) |
